notes.title: Content Update: Arcade Builder ROM Preview.
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Arcade Gamers,[/b]

Hi everyone, we have pushed out a minor content update which you can view below:

[b]Added[/b] - Changed the arcade builder to have a new button "Preview In-Game & Save" when editing an arcade cabinet/cartridge or gamebro. This will allow for to load a small map and check the game you're adding is running correctly, without the need to enter the arcade.

[b]Fixed[/b] - Emulator Options system to allow libretro-core specific options to be set correctly on more emulators.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25478790/e0399c283ffa5edd3a2063bfc30d23b0e68ac95a.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25478790/7b2f1a741a94a4db13c3a4a7662efc11dbb31f52.png[/img]

Our Trello support board  allows you to keep track on the progress of development:
[b]https://trello.com/b/xc1WU1Fx/newretroarcade-neon-support[/b]

[b]Your Community Manager Joe & the rest of the Digital Cybercherries team.[/b]

notes.title: HOTFIX – Fixed Movement Acceleration With Touch.
notes.notes:
[b]Dear NRA:N fans,[/b]

I hope the New Year has treated you well. Today we a have few small fixes that should help improve your gameplay experience. ([i]Mainly with Touch[/i])

View the current status of development by visiting our Trello support board below:
[b]https://trello.com/b/xc1WU1Fx/newretroarcade-neon-support[/b]
[list]
[*][h1]Here are the latest patch notes:[/h1]

[*][b]Fixed[/b] movement acceleration with Touch.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] teleport rotation with Touch.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] default TXAA setting for improved quality in VR.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] coming soon poster LOD's.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] arcade 'disabled' machine in Classic.

[/list]
That’s it for today. Have a fantastic rest of your week!

[b]Your Community Manager Joe and the rest of The Digital Cybercherries team.[/b]

notes.title: PATCH NOTES #06 - Arcade Emulator options added, lots of fixes & much more!
notes.notes:
Dear Community,

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25478790/31277ca518be4b3c7630a2571b8649742b22fc54.jpg[/img]

Thank you for the continuous support you have shown us, it really does mean a lot. I'd also like to point out that we are very thankful to much of the community for being so helpful to other members. It's fantastic to see that already we have a strong-tied community always looking out for each other. Keep it up. 

While I am on the topic of saying thank you, there is one more thanks we would like to give. Since the release of Neon, we have received a significant amount of help on the forums from a person who many know as [i][b]Vermillion.[/b][/i] He moderates the forums and has put a countless amount of hours in not only the forum, but also other aspects of the game, all with the mind set of wanting to further enhance Neon. We consider him a good friend and when it comes to him being a Moderator, he really is one of a kind. Thank you so much Matthew (Vermillion) for all the hard work you have / are putting into New Retro Arcade: Neon. 

As always, we are keeping track of your feedback on the forums and social media. Thank you once again.

You can see the current status of development by visiting our Trello support board below:
[b]https://trello.com/b/xc1WU1Fx/newretroarcade-neon-support[/b]
[list]
[*][h1]Here are the latest patch notes:[/h1]

[/list]
[list]

[*][b]Fixed[/b] Game bro back lighting.  You can enable the back light in the GameUserSettings.ini by adding the line “bHandHeldScreenLight=True” alternatively you can launch the game the launch options "-HandHeldLight"

[*][b]Libretro[/b] cores should now output their internal core parameter options
[*][b]Added[/b] “ArcadeEmulatorOptions.xml” for overriding or adding core specific options, such as enabling cheats, throttle or boot to OSD. Example below:

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<EmulatorOptions>
   <mame_boot_to_osd        value="disabled" />
   <mame_throttle                value="enabled" />
   <mame_cheats_enable    value="enabled" />
</EmulatorOptions>

[*][b]Fixed[/b] Attract and Game audio volume on cabinets.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] Attract Screens audio breaking when used on over 30 Arcades Machines at once.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] intrusive bright glows and over bright reflections on Arcade Machine control panels.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] flickering buildings in the main menu skybox.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] missing screen-space reflections in Classic map.

[*][b]Fixed[/b] a gap in the arcade walls which leaked into the void.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] duplicate phone sound in classic map. The sound will also now stop when the phone is placed on receiver.
[*][b] Removed [/b]unfitting background ambient sounds from the world.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] non-movable props on the bar in Neon map.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] fire extinguisher location on the wall in the bar on Neon.
[*][b]Removed[/b] all Halloween content.
[/list]
We'd like to give a huge thank you to the team at [url=http://www.libretro.com] Libretro[/url] for all of their amazing work on the emulator cores supported by New Retro Arcade: Neon.
[list]
[b]Hans-Kristian "Themaister" Arntzen
Daniel "Twinaphex" De Matteis
Jean-André "kivutar" Santoni
Andrés "radius" Suárez
Higor "enygmata" Eurípedes
Toad King
Alcaro
Aliaspider
Hunter "hunterk" Kaller[/b]
[/list]
Your Community Manager Joe and the rest of The Digital Cybercherries team.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES #05: Huge amount of fixes! – Thank you for the on-going feedback.
notes.notes:
Dear Community,

Monday is here again [i](where does time go?!)[/i] and we have a lot of fixes that have now been pushed. Your feedback and suggestions are extremely appreciated, you are helping shape New Retro Arcade: Neon into the perfect retro arcade. Keep it up everyone!

On a side-note, we are very proud that New Retro Arcade: Neon was an honoree for Best Social Experience at [url=https://www.protoawards.com/]The Proto Awards[/url] See more below:

https://www.protoawards.com/

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25478790/3433556cb1e3cf8ad113e13bbe0a1bcdea55c310.png[/img]

Also, YouTuber [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Siq3ZdCaOQA] Mithzan [/url]uploaded his video of New Retro Arcade: Neon. It seems he had quite a lot of fun! Find out for yourself:  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Siq3ZdCaOQA
View the current status of development by visiting our Trello support board below:
[b]https://trello.com/b/xc1WU1Fx/newretroarcade-neon-support[/b]
[list]
[*][h1]Here are the latest patch notes:[/h1]

[*][b]Fixed[/b] Attract screen video not filling screen correctly
[*][b]Fixed[/b] Attract screen audio. Support for positional audio has now been added
[*][b]Fixed[/b] VIVE 'walk' slide movement occurring when playing machines
[*][b]Fixed[/b] VIVE resolution being reset on restart for certain machines

[*][b]Fixed[/b] handling of emulator resolution changing (Games such as Tekken 3)
[*][b]Fixed[/b] NVRAM folder not being created correctly
[*][b]Fixed[/b] OSD access for changing settings, dip switches and various other menu options
[*][b]Fixed[/b] game save states not working correctly

[*][b]Fixed[/b] haptic feedback (vibrations) happening on XBOX 360 controllers
[*][b]Fixed[/b] 'secret' button not being pressed when using motion controllers
[*][b]Fixed[/b] Whac a Mole motion controller held position
[*][b]Fixed[/b] vending machine button and various sound fixes

[/list]
Your Community Manager Joe & the rest of the Digital Cybercherries team.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES #04 – Huge update - Bar area added & much more!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25478790/24fee9afeb817a79b1befdf7387665477f7e6c74.png[/img]
[h1]Bar area now added to Neon.[/h1]
	
Dear Community,

It's been nearly 2 weeks since the release of New Retro Arcade: Neon and what a couple of weeks it has been. As many of you will already know, the launch did not go as smoothly as it could have. Our attempt to add additional content at the last minute led to unexpected issues arising. Some features were not fully functional and others did not meet expectations.

We are truly grateful that the community has rallied around us and been so supportive as we work to improve and expand the experience. The understanding the community has shown, even throughout this bumpy start, means the world to us. 

We will continue working hard to update the game; we have already released many fixes and patches, as well as taking on board all feedback. To show our appreciation our art team has been expanding the Arcade, even as the coders rectify the issues. It’s been a long couple of weeks with some very late nights, but finally we’re proud to announce that the Arcade Bar is now open!

With your continued support, we can and will make New Retro Arcade: Neon one of the best VR games. Thank you.
 
[i]As I mention quite a lot, we have a Trello support board which gives you the ability to view the current status of development. See more below:[/i]

[b]https://trello.com/b/xc1WU1Fx/newretroarcade-neon-support[/b]

[list]
[*][h1]Here are the latest patch notes:[/h1]

[/list]
[list]

 [*][b]Added[/b] Bar Area to Neon map. [*][b]Added[/b] games console trigger input, right trigger should no longer press 'B'.
 [*][b] Added [/b] more Arcade Cabinets, Gamebros & VHS Tapes to maps.
 
 [*][b]Added[/b] map overviews to the ArcadeBuilder with item locations. [*][b] Added [/b] fixed Prompt system for controllers. ([i]This will not affect your current XML files. To configure the additional cabinets and VHS Tapes in the Builder, you will need to revert to the new .defaults files or edit your existing XMLs to include the new items.[/i])

[*][b] Added [/b] Added VoIP prompt system. (See the options menu for your default key.)
[*][b] Added [/b] Added customizable VHS Tape labels.
[*][b] Added [/b] Added support for DualShock4.

[*][b]Fixed[/b] multiplayer servers not properly ending sessions.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] Keybinding locking up the screen.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] controller prompts, these should now be displayed correctly.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] Bowling Alley scoring and sounds.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] Boxing Machine hit detection for motion controllers.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] stat based achivements not correctly registering.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] Server Hosts hearing multiple flashlight sounds. 

[*][b]Updated[/b] the Projector networking to increase stability and added a video quality override for lower speed connections. To enable lower quality video simply add the following text to your steam launch option: -lowvideotest.

[*][b] Added [/b] High Quality Audio Tracks for the Soundtrack (Files are now available as FLAC)
[*][b] Added [/b] 5 Playalong Audio Tracks for the guitar (sorted by different skill levels):

You can download them by visiting the link below:
[i]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/1357989/NRAN%20Playbacks.zip[/i]


[/list]
Thank you so much for sticking by us. As our slogan states; we are Powered By You.

Your Community Manager Joe and the rest of The Digital Cybercherries team.

 [*][b]Fixed[/b] Vive motion controllers being off in specific directions.
 [*][b]Fixed[/b] issues with the Gamebro. Sound is now working.
 [*][b]Fixed[/b] the broken white highlight lines with multi-res.
 [*][b]Fixed[/b] crackling audio on the games console.
 [*][b]Fixed[/b] glitched in-game borders for Oculus.
 [*][b]Fixed[/b] missing LODs on some of the Hats.
 [*][b]Fixed[/b] in game settings saving.
 [*][b]Fixed[/b] VHS Materials.

 [*][b]Added[/b] haptic feedback to the games consoles and arcade cabinets.
 [*][b]Lowered[/b] internal floor height to help with Vive calibration.
 [*][b]Disabled[/b] testing commands being bound to certain keys.

[/list]

Once again, we sincerely thank you for sticking by us.

Your Community Manager Joe and the rest of The Digital Cybercherries team.

notes.title: BUG FIX - We are listening!
notes.notes:
Dear Community,

We've unfortunately had to pull VOIP from the client for now as we ran into some unexpected issues with the system that only came to light at the 11th hour. Our attempts to disable it at the last second, however, left the system in an even more broken state. We've fully disabled the system for now, and we'll get it working and in as soon as possible.

There's some extra safety checking been added to the video url system.
The arcade builder should also be fixed up and properly modifying the configuration files now.

We understand this must be very frustrating for you. We are working tirelessly in making sure we fix any problems you are experiencing. We’re constantly listening to your feedback on the forums and social media. We hope you will be patient with us during the first day of launch. 

[b]Your Community Manager Joe and the rest of the Digital Cybercherries team.[/b]
